column1: # Design-review packet definition (docs/DESIGN_REVIEW.md, T027).
# Pipe-separated rows; blank lines and #-comments are ignored.
# session|name|seed|video|window|script|fixtures|label
#   One capture session of the real application. `script` is relative to
#   the repository root. `fixtures` lists the labeled board fixtures the
#   session loads, or - for a normal game from an empty board.
# image|session|checkpoint|id|scene|covers|expected
#   One reviewed image. `checkpoint` is the script `check` name whose BMP
#   the packet converts to PNG under `images/<id>.png`. `scene` is the
#   observation scene the record must show. `covers` names the required
#   review coverage the frame carries; `expected` states what the frame
#   must show, pinned from docs/SPEC.md.
# The image count stays within the round bound of twelve images, and the
# review driver batches them six per call.
session|scenes|31337|dummy|960x544|tests/harness/scripts/design-review-scenes.script.txt|-|normal game from an empty board; keyboard input; one tick per frame
session|clears|31337|dummy|960x544|tests/harness/scripts/design-review-clears.script.txt|four-line-ready|labeled fixture session; the four-line clear no blind script reaches
session|tall-stack|31337|dummy|960x544|tests/harness/scripts/design-review-tall-stack.script.txt|tall-stack-ready|labeled fixture session; a tall uneven stack with a forced T piece
session|letterbox|31337|x11|640x480|tests/harness/scripts/design-review-letterbox.script.txt|-|real-time session under Xvfb and openbox; the driver resizes the window to 640x480
image|scenes|dr-title|title|title|title menu|STACKFALL logo, START GAME selected, CONTROLS, OPTIONS, and QUIT items, the high-score line, and the hint line
image|scenes|dr-controls|controls|controls|controls screen|the two mapping columns (gamepad, keyboard) with one action per row, the heading, and the back hint

image|scenes|dr-gameplay-early|gameplay-early|playing|early gameplay, ghost, hold available, five previews|the focused HUD of the approved composition: the S piece fully visible near the top with its ghost outline at the floor, HOLD empty and the score, lines, and level at zero in the left statistics column beside the board, the five NEXT pieces in queue order Z O L I J on the right with the first at full color and the rest quieter, no control hints anywhere, and the outer regions of the canvas empty
image|scenes|dr-hold-locked|hold-locked|playing|hold unavailable|the HOLD box shows the stashed Z at reduced brightness, the O piece in play, and L I J T O in NEXT

image|scenes|dr-pause|pause|paused|pause overlay|a dimmed board behind the PAUSED panel nested between the HUD columns, RESUME selected with RESTART, CONTROLS, and QUIT TO TITLE below, the frozen statistics and previews still readable beside the panel

image|scenes|dr-gameover|gameover|gameover|game over with a new record|the GAME OVER panel nested between the HUD columns with the final score, lines, and level, the new-record mark, PLAY AGAIN selected, the topped-out board dimmed behind, and the dimmed statistics and previews readable beside the panel

image|scenes|dr-restart-spawn|restart-spawn|playing|restart; spawn sequence frame 1|the frame under the PLAY AGAIN press: an empty board, the S fully visible at once in the top two rows of its spawn columns (immediate spawn, T029), the ghost at the floor, and the statistics column back at zero
image|scenes|dr-spawn-visible|spawn-visible|playing|spawn sequence frame 2|the same restarted round 52 ticks later: the S fully visible two rows down, the ghost unchanged at the floor
image|clears|dr-clear-before|clear-before|playing|line-clear sequence frame 1|four settled rows each missing column 5, the vertical I in column 5 above them, and its ghost already filling the gap
image|clears|dr-clear-after|clear-after|playing|line-clear sequence frame 2|the four rows gone and the band empty, score 836, lines 4, the next piece spawning

image|tall-stack|dr-tall-stack|tall-stack|playing|tall stack|the uneven stack filling roughly rows 6..19 with one hole per bottom row, the T piece in flight above it, and its ghost outline resting on the stack top

image|letterbox|dr-letterboxed-640x480|letterbox-640x480|playing|smaller letterboxed window|the whole 960x544 scene scaled by two thirds to 640x363, centered in the 640x480 window so the letterbox bars split evenly above and below, with the board, both panels, and the text still readable
